messages.content: "請問你能幫我做幾個計算嗎？首先，我需要用歐幾里得算法找出56和98的最大公因數。接著，我想知道81和27的最大公因數，但這次要用二進制算法。完成後，我需要用標準算法計算出15和25的最小公倍數。最後，你能用簡化算法找出21和14的最小公倍數嗎？"

4. LCM of 21 and 14 using reduced algorithm.

We should do them sequentially. We can call calculate_gcd for first with algorithm "euclidean". Then second with algorithm "binary". Then calculate_lcm for third with method "standard". Then calculate_lcm for fourth with method "reduced".
